_help: For each round: bin colour -> what goes in that bin. An entry is a colour (red, blue, green, yellow), a YOLO class (cube, cylinder, dodecahedron, hexagonal) or both ('yellow cube'). 'round' picks the rules sort_objects.py uses; --round overrides it. From the Game 1 rules (Rules & Regulations v0.5, 5.8.1.34 and 5.8.1.41).
